LMD Trading Operations Center

Live trading dashboard · Tradovate Position History · Eastern futures day 18:00–17:00

Live data loads from data/live.json when available; embedded v17 snapshot is retained as a fallback. Trade P&L is sourced from Position History; Cash History provides recorded fees and balances. Return % is calculated from imported trade P&L divided by starting capital plus deposits ($3,144.92), as shown in your Cash_Flows sheet; it may differ from the Google dashboard until P&L and fees are reconciled. Entry timestamps are interpreted as Eastern time. Research data is never included in live metrics.
